Engineering Your Future, Together.
At our core, we are here to help you grow from curious learner to confident innovator. At UTRGV's College of Engineering and Computer Science you can engage in exciting research and access state-of-the-art programsâwhether that includes creating sustainable tech, evolving the digital world or building smarter cities. Whatever path you choose, you'll have the guidance and tools to leave your mark in this fast-changing world.
Apply Now
Explore Programs
Launch Your Future in Engineering and Computer Science at UTRGV
Innovation. Hands-on learning. A supportive community. That’s a glimpse of your future educational experience in the College of Engineering and Computer Science at The University of Texas Rio Grande Valley (UTRGV). Whether you're passionate about building sustainable infrastructure, designing intelligent systems, or securing the digital world, our accredited programs and cutting-edge labs will prepare you to lead in today’s high-tech industries. Join a vibrant campus where your ideas matter, and your education is designed to launch a successful and meaningful career in STEM.
